edits.current: THE PRINCIPAL PAYROLL CASILLA ON THE WITHHOLDING SIDE. Sum of the income-tax withholding at source actually practised on work income paid to natural persons in the calendar month, across EVERY payroll run of the entity in that month (not only the regular run), in whole pesos, then rounded once to the nearest 1,000. Sources in the client's payroll: WT 2552 'Income Tax (employee)' (Deductions), plus WT 21330 'Personal Income Tax Withholding (Theoretical)' for the employees whose WT 2552 line is a zero-value Non Cash item and whose deduction is booked on WT 21330 (6 of 261 employees in the Sep-2026 run). Together they reconcile exactly to the Base of Withholding column V 'WITHOLDING TAX WITH CONTRIBUTION' (per employee, 2552 = V for 255 of 261 and 21330 = V for the other 6; run total 1,468,500,598). The same per-employee amount is reported as RetencionFuente (NIE177) in the client's electronic payroll documents of the same pay group and run (261 of 261 employees; total 1,468,500,598). Do NOT use column X 'WITHOLDING TAX WITHOUT CONTRIBUTION'. The Base of Withholding and the G2N cover one pay group and one payroll run only (G2N title 'Pay Group(s)' = CO - Monthly): in Sep-2026 the Accumulated Report holds a further 144,635,503 of WT 2552 for 97 IDs not in that run (93 paid weekly / exceptional advances WT 61100 'Weekly advance' / WT 62838 'Exceptional Advance', 42,067,461; 4 paid termination or settlement items such as WT 62116 / 62110 / 62203 / 62115, 102,568,042), so the casilla is built from every pay group and every payroll run of the month, not from one report. Do not use the report 'Payroll id' as the run key: the same run carries a different Payroll id in the Base of Withholding and in the G2N / Master Data reports. [DECISION PENDING - see Query to RA] (a) whether CONTINGENT WITHHOLDING (column Y, = X - V, present only for employees with AFC or voluntary-pension contributions and not deducted by any wage type) is excluded from this casilla; (b) whether withholding booked on WT 21129 (Terminations), 25832 (Stock awards vesting), 25833 (IC Local Country) and 25834 (Hypothetical - IC Foreign Country), and on the theoretical-tax WTs 21114 (Theoretical income Tax-5011) and 21619 (Theoretical Income Tax - Ajuste - 5035), enters here in the month it is practised - the client's electronic-payroll mapping reports all of them as RetencionFuente (NIE177), but that is client practice, not confirmation that 25834, 21114 and 21619 are withholding actually practised; (c) whether withholding on the employees withheld at a flat 20% of gross income (client Tax Procedure 3; inferred from the rate to be the ET art. 408 non-resident withholding - no report labels them non-resident) is reported here or in casillas 111/112. Must reconcile to the sum of RetencionFuente (NIE177) across every electronic payroll document for the same month, after the nearest-1,000 rounding. It is one of the forty-two casillas summed into casilla 130.
edits.proposed: THE PRINCIPAL PAYROLL CASILLA ON THE WITHHOLDING SIDE. Sum of the income-tax withholding at source actually practised on work income paid to natural persons in the calendar month, across EVERY pay group and EVERY payroll run of the entity in that month - regular, weekly or exceptional-advance, termination and settlement runs alike - in whole pesos, then rounded once to the nearest 1,000 (ET art. 577). Source: wage type 2552 'Income Tax (employee)' (Deductions), plus wage type 21330 'Personal Income Tax Withholding (Theoretical)' for the employees whose WT 2552 line is a zero-value Non Cash item and whose withholding is deducted on WT 21330. The amount is the withholding actually deducted from the employee's pay, computed with the employee's AFC and voluntary-pension contributions (ET arts. 126-1 and 126-4) taken into account; never the figure computed without those contributions. Contingent withholding - the difference between the withholding computed without and with those contributions, which is not deducted by any wage type - is not withholding practised and is excluded. WT 2552 withholding deducted in advance runs (WT 61100 'Weekly advance', WT 62838 'Exceptional Advance') and in termination or settlement runs (WT 62116, 62110, 62203, 62115) enters in the month it is practised, whatever the run. Withholding deducted on WT 21129 (Terminations), 25832 (Stock awards vesting) and 25833 (IC Local Country) enters in the month it is practised. Rule to be set at implementation: whether WT 25834 (Hypothetical - IC Foreign Country) and the theoretical-tax wage types 21114 (Theoretical income Tax-5011) and 21619 (Theoretical Income Tax - Ajuste - 5035) carry withholding actually practised; they enter casilla 93 only where they do, and the wage-type to casilla-93 mapping table is a configuration parameter supplied at implementation. Withholding at the flat 20% of ET art. 408 on a NON-RESIDENT employee is not reported here: it is supplied as sheet-2 rows (casillas 141-146) and rolls into casillas 111 / 112; the employee's tax-residence flag, not the withholding rate or the tax-procedure code, decides the sheet. Accumulate by the payroll engine's run key (pay group and run), not by a report-level identifier. Must reconcile to the sum of RetencionFuente (NIE177) across every electronic payroll document for the same month, after the nearest-1,000 rounding. It is one of the forty-two casillas summed into casilla 130.

edits.current: Country of TAX RESIDENCE of the non-resident payee (for a treaty claim, the country on the residence certificate), expressed with the country code required by the DIAN Form 350 sheet-2 list (code standard to be confirmed by RA - see Query to RA). Do not derive it from Nationality. If the HR address country (Master Data 'Country') is used as a fallback it must be normalised to one consistent form (the client data holds 'co' and 'cr' alongside 'CO' and 'CR') and converted to the DIAN code; note that Nationality and address Country name different countries for 15 employees, so neither attribute is tax residence by itself. Where 'Treaty status' (casilla 141) = CON CONVENIO the country must be one with a treaty in force. Colombia's treaty network in force includes Spain, Chile, Switzerland, Canada, Mexico, South Korea, Portugal, India, the Czech Republic, the United Kingdom, France, Italy and Japan, plus Andean Community Decision 578.
edits.proposed: Country of TAX RESIDENCE of the non-resident payee (for a treaty claim, the country on the residence certificate), expressed with the country code required by the DIAN Form 350 sheet-2 list. Do not derive it from Nationality. Where the address country (Master Data field 'Country') is used as a fallback it must be normalised to one consistent upper-case form and converted to the DIAN code; neither Nationality nor address Country is tax residence by itself, and the two may name different countries. Where 'Treaty status' (casilla 141) = CON CONVENIO the country must be one with a treaty in force. Colombia's treaty network in force includes Spain, Chile, Switzerland, Canada, Mexico, South Korea, Portugal, India, the Czech Republic, the United Kingdom, France, Italy and Japan, plus Andean Community Decision 578.

unrewritable: Formulario 350 Spec!M23 (93): 'whether withholding booked on ... 25834 (Hypothetical - IC Foreign Country), and on the theoretical-tax WTs 21114 (Theoretical income Tax-5011) and 21619 (Theoretical Income Tax - Ajuste - 5035), enters here in the month it is practised' - the spec's own rule (casilla 93 = withholding actually practised) does not say whether these three wage types carry withholding actually practised, so the proposed text carries one neutral 'Rule to be set at implementation' sentence and makes the wage-type to casilla-93 mapping a configuration parameter.

The parenthesis is dropped from M39 and the question survives only in column T (script-handled).

Formulario 350 Spec!M37 (142): 'NOTE the documentation conflict recorded in the RA query column.' - the conflict (DIAN Resolution 000227 of 2025 art. 1.2.2.26 para. 3 citing 'casilla 91' and option codes that do not match the current form's casilla 142 list) is a source conflict, not a rule; dropped from M37, survives only in column T (script-handled).
